description: DART Bus Schedules is a dataset listed in State of Delaware open data portal (data.delaware.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Delaware. This contains all the routes, stop location, stop times, and trip information for all DART bus routes. Coverage: Delaware. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are schedule, dart, route, trip, bus. The table has 25 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation, Delaware Transit Corportation. The portal shows 2019-10-30 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-delaware-gov-portal.
